description: This file declares functions, variables, and structures related to handling a pager component within a version control system, including setup, usage checks, and terminal control.

methods.name: git_pager
methods.description: Returns a string indicating which pager command to use for a given repository, considering whether stdout is a terminal.

methods.name: setup_pager
methods.description: Initializes pager settings for a repository.

methods.name: wait_for_pager
methods.description: Waits for the pager process to complete.

methods.name: pager_in_use
methods.description: Checks whether a pager is currently in use.

methods.name: term_columns
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the terminal.

methods.name: term_clear_line
methods.description: Clears the current line in the terminal.

methods.name: decimal_width
methods.description: Calculates the decimal width needed for a given integer.

methods.name: check_pager_config
methods.description: Checks the configuration for the pager command in the repository.

methods.name: prepare_pager_args
methods.description: Prepares the argument list for a child process to run the pager.
